name: YNAB Operator

values.description: YNAB API base URL. Do not change unless testing against a mock server.
Your YNAB Personal Access Token. Generate at https://app.ynab.com/settings/developer
Your default budget ID. Run 'List Plans' to find it.
An account ID for account-scoped requests. Run 'List Accounts' to find IDs.
Second account ID used in transfer transaction examples.
A category ID. Run 'List Categories' to find IDs.
Second category ID used in split transaction examples.
A category group ID. Available in the 'List Categories' response under data.category_groups[].id.
A transaction ID. Run 'List Transactions' and copy any id field.
A payee ID. Run 'List Payees' to find IDs.
A payee location ID. Run 'List Payee Locations' to find IDs.
A scheduled transaction ID. Run 'List Scheduled Transactions' to find IDs.
ISO date for the first day of a month. Used in month-scoped requests.
Save the server_knowledge value from any response here to use in delta sync requests.

description: Operator environment for the YNAB API. Fill in api_key and plan_id at minimum. All other variables are populated as you explore the API.
